Team,

I'm circulating a nomination for Senior Staff SWE (candidate: A.) and want to lock down the evidence custody and committee blackout window before we open the packet to the committee. High level asks:

- Confirm final packet (attached) is good to share to committee after redactions.
- Agree a 3-day blackout window for edits and escalation (recommended 2026-08-02 -> 2026-08-04).
- Decide who holds the canonical packet and who acts as evidence steward for sensitive artifacts.

Context: the packet contains customer references and a short excerpt of a joint engagement with Acme Analytics (their name must be redacted in the public excerpts). Elena (People Ops) is CC'd to confirm compliance and DocuSign timeline.

Attachments: MK_SeniorStaff_Packet_v1.pdf (full packet, unredacted), redaction_instructions_v2.docx

Next steps I propose: Marissa to shepherd redaction pass, Soojin to confirm security redaction checklist, Dylan to own canonical packet custody and upload to the secure drive, Elena to confirm committee window and DocuSign steps.

Please reply with firm confirmations and any conflicts by EOD Monday 2026-07-20.

Thanks,

Markus Klein
Director, Platform Engineering

- The proposed blackout 2026-08-02 -> 2026-08-04 works for me, but note that the EU-based committee members have a standing conflict on 2026-08-03 morning (calendar event). If we need full attendance we should avoid that morning.
- Suggest Dylan hold canonical packet in the private team Drive folder with versioning and an audit log (Dylan, confirm).

Thanks — a few security-redaction items from my side:

- Replace explicit customer names with place-holder tokens (e.g., [Customer X]), but keep the neutral contextual detail (impact metrics, timelines).
- Remove or hash any IP addresses and internal endpoint identifiers.
- For code snippets: if they reveal internal logic that could be sensitive, keep only pseudo-code and link to the secure code excerpt (not embedded).

Dylan — for packet custody please use the secure Drive folder with restricted share (only the four of us + Elena). Enable version history and notify audit-logs@redwood.com when you upload.

I also recommend we schedule a short pre-read call (20 minutes) for the committee to run through the redacted highlights — propose 2026-08-01 09:00 PT / 17:00 CET (this would avoid the EU morning conflict Marissa flagged).

Soojin Lee
Engineering Security Lead

- Committee window: 2026-08-01 (pre-read call 20m at 09:00 PT / 17:00 CET), formal review 2026-08-02 10:00 PT (we'll avoid the 08-03 EU conflict).
- DocuSign/approvals: I'll initiate the approval envelope on 2026-07-26 so reviewers have the redacted packet and the signature flow aligned with the blackout.
- Custody: acceptable that Dylan holds canonical in the secure Drive folder. Please ensure the upload includes the redaction_instructions_v2.docx and a short changelog.txt (who touched the packet and when).
- Sensitive external mentions: Sarah from Acme is BCC'd for the record (we have explicit permission for reference, but the public excerpt must be redacted).

I will open an internal People Ops ticket and paste the DocuSign link into this thread once the envelope is created. If anyone has legal concerns call them out now — otherwise I will proceed.
